questions.question: Paul wrote that the ministry of the Spirit is even more glorious than the ministry of death engraved on stone. True or false?
Paul wrote that a veil stays over the reading of the old covenant. In whom can it be removed?
Paul wrote that a veil covers the hearts of people when Moses is read. When is that veil taken away?

answers.text: Whenever anyone turns to the Lord
Whenever the old glory fades out

questions.question: What does Paul say is happening to those who reflect the glory of the Lord with unveiled faces?

answers.text: They are being transformed into His image
They are being sent out to all nations
They are being given a new name
